YouTubeLogin evaluateJavascript rewrite taken. Added takeIf(String::isNotBlank) guards: YOUTUBE_VISITOR_DATA defaults to CHROME_WINDOWS_VISITOR_DATA, so blanking it on a 'null' JS result would break PO-token minting. Same guard on the new YouTube.* startup assignment in MainApplication.

Home*ViewModel refactor taken. Added the missing distinctBy in HomeAlbums/HomeArtists/HomeLibraryViewModel (confirmed crash: items(key = Album::id) over online+local), Reverted a first attempt to re-wire importYTMLikedAlbums/importYTMSubscribedChannels for offline persistence: isYouTubeSyncEnabled() gates on YOUTUBE_PLAYLISTS_SYNC (not the albums/artists prefs) so it mostly no-ops, its un-flag pass nulls bookmarkedAt for anything not in FEmusic_liked_albums, and it does blocking Room writes on Main. Synced YT albums/artists are therefore online-only now -- a real regression needing a proper fix.

DatabaseInitCallback kept OUT. Confirmed: schema 36 columns really are snake_case, so the DELETEs execute; From35To36Migration strips the local: prefix from songs.id without touching song_playlist_map/lyrics/formats/playback_history, so every local file's playlist rows would be wiped on next open. Needs a repair migration (36->37) before the cleanup can ship.
HomeQuickPicks hunk (ArtistItem.Thumbnail sizeDp) came in; the real chart fix still needs the modules/innertube bump, which needs SSH access.
